description: This file defines an Android Fragment named VisibilityMetadataFragment. Its purpose is to demonstrate the differences in notification visibility levels (public, private, secret) on the lockscreen. It provides UI elements to select visibility levels and create notifications with corresponding visibility metadata.

classes.name: VisibilityMetadataFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating notification visibility levels with UI controls.

methods.description: Builds a notification with the specified visibility level.
